 Here are our three favorite lenders for VA loans.
 Published Wed, Nov 4 2026 Kelsey Neubauer Reporter, CNBC Select Share Share Article via Facebook Share Article via Twitter Share Article via LinkedIn Share Article via Email The 30-year fixed-rate for VA loans is 6.80% as of today, according to data released by Optimal Blue. That's slightly higher than Monday. 
 The Optimal Blue Mortgage Market Indices is an average of locked rates during the weekday prior across a third of all mortgage providers in the U.S.
 VA loans — mortgages backed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs — are designed to help veterans and active service members become homeowners. These loans require no down payment , have lower interest rates than conventional loans and don't need private mortgage insurance if you put less than 20% down. 
 It's a great option for anyone who has served and especially those who haven't saved much up for a down payment. Below, CNBC Select highlights the best VA loan lenders based on a homebuyer's priorities.
 Talk to us Are you living paycheck to paycheck, or do you have a financial success you're comfortable sharing with a reporter? Please fill out this quick form . 
 Best VA loan lenders 
 If you want the best customer service: Veterans United  
 Why we love it : Veterans United consistently receives top ratings from J.D. Power and the Better Business Bureau. It also has a 24/7 phone line. 
 We also like that Veterans United goes beyond the loan process to help members of the military and their families. It offers free credit counseling to help you boost your credit before you apply for a mortgage — which can help you get a better rate. Additionally, it has a sister foundation, Veterans United Foundation, which raises money for organizations that support military families. 
 Veterans United

 Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, refinancing, HELOC, home equity loan
 Terms

 Minimum credit score
 620 for conventional, 500 for FHA
 Minimum down payment
 0% for VA loan, 3% for conventional, 3.5% for FHA
 If you want the lowest rates: Navy Federal Credit Union 
 Why we love it : Navy Federal offers VA loan rates that are consistently below the industry average — often even better than competitors with lower-than-average rates. 
 Navy Federal also has another 0% down payment option for military members. Plus, for a $250 fee, borrowers can lower their mortgage rate without refinancing, a huge bonus for anyone who bought when rates were high.

 If you want to apply and manage your loan online: Rocket Mortgage  
 Why we love it : Rocket has great customer service ratings, plus an excellent website and easy-to-use app. You can also do a portion of your closing remotely, a perk not all lenders offer. 
 Rocket also offers closing credits — or cash you can put toward closing costs —  for those who use their partner real estate agents at Redfin. 
 Rocket Mortgage
